svg.title: The feature matrix, part by part
svg.desc: Feature matrix. Host, firmware and boot loader: Hypervisor (done); Firmware (done); Boot loader (done); APFS driver for the boot loader (in progress); boot.efi (in progress) | Kernel: Apple's 27.0.1 x86_64 kernel (done); Self-built kernel (done); Kernel soak (done); DEVELOPMENT build of the self-built kernel (in progress); Running arm64e programs as themselves (done) | Kernel extensions: Kernel collection contents (in progress); Kernel collection builder (in progress); Sandbox kext (done); Platform kexts with no 27 x86_64 build (in progress); Real-time clock kext (in progress) | Boot-path userland: dyld and the shared cache (done); Boot volume (done); pid 1 (launchd) and xpcproxy (done); Boot tasks (done); Daemons (in progress); Unified logging (in progress); Code-signing daemon (amfid) (in progress); sandboxd (in progress); Kernel extension management (in progress) | Network and remote access: Network interface (done); DHCP (done); ssh (in progress) | Graphics and desktop: WindowServer, hybrid image (in progress); WindowServer, 27-only root (in progress); GPU (not started); Desktop (loginwindow, Dock, Finder, SystemUIServer) (in progress) | Translation tooling: Lifter (arm64/arm64e function to C) (done); User-space differential test (done); Link tools (done); Kext adapter generator (done); Kernel-side differential test (in progress); Third-party user-space translator (in progress); Mutation tests of the tools' self-tests (done)
svg.text: The feature matrix, part by part
One tile per row of docs/components.md, a column per area. As of 2026-11-25.
